steps.name: environment - verify runtimes and persist safe globals
steps.description: Verify node/npm >=18.x are present, determine the workspace owner robustly, compute npm global bin safely handling root vs non-root, create workspace, idempotently write /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh (only when changed) to export CI=true if not already set and to add npm global bin to PATH. Do not rely on sudo -u $(whoami); handle running-as-root case. Validate sudo is usable for writing /etc/profile.d. Fail with clear messages when preconditions are not met.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
mkdir -p "$WS"
# ensure node/npm exist
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 3; }
node_ver=$(node -p "process.versions.node")
# numeric semver parse major.minor
IFS=. read -r node_major node_minor _ <<EOF
$node_ver
EOF
node_major=${node_major:-0}
node_minor=${node_minor:-0}
if [ "$node_major" -lt 18 ] || { [ "$node_major" -eq 18 ] && [ "$node_minor" -lt 0 ]; }; then
  echo "Node version $node_ver detected; require Node >=18.0.0" >&2
  exit 4
fi
# determine workspace owner (fallback to current user)
owner=$(stat -c '%U' "$WS" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$owner" ] || [ "$owner" = "root" ]; then
  # if root owns workspace, prefer to treat effective operator as current user
  owner=$(id -un 2>/dev/null || echo root)
fi
# compute npm global bin robustly for owner; if running as root, use /usr/local/bin
npm_gbin="/usr/local/bin"
if [ "$owner" != "root" ] && sudo -n -u "$owner" true 2>/dev/null; then
  npm_gbin=$(sudo -n -u "$owner" sh -lc 'npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || printf ""' || true)
fi
if [ -z "$npm_gbin" ]; then npm_gbin="/usr/local/bin"; fi
# verify sudo available to write profile.d
if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "sudo not available without password; required to persist /etc/profile.d changes" >&2
  exit 5
fi
# prepare idempotent profile snippet (do not override CI if explicitly set in environment)
tmp=$(mktemp)
cat >"$tmp" <<EOF
# Generated by playwright setup - will add npm global bin and CI if not set
# DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

# add npm global bin if missing
if ! echo "\$PATH" | /bin/grep -q -F "$npm_gbin"; then
  export PATH="$npm_gbin:\$PATH"
fi
# export CI only if not already set
if [ -z "${CI:-}" ]; then
  export CI=true
fi
# ensure PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD is not set for installs
unset PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD || true
EOF
sudo mkdir -p /etc/profile.d
if sudo cmp -s "$tmp" /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh 2>/dev/null; then
  rm -f "$tmp"
else
  sudo mv "$tmp" /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh && sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh
fi
# source for immediate effect (best-effort)
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh || true
# record versions for traceability
mkdir -p "$WS/.artifacts"
printf "%s\n%s\n" "node:$node_ver" "npm:$(npm -v)" > "$WS/.artifacts/runtime_versions.txt"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Workspace from container context
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
mkdir -p "$WS"

# ensure node/npm exist
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node not found; please install Node >=18.x" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm not found; please install npm" >&2; exit 3; }
# get node semver
node_ver=$(node -p "process.versions.node")
IFS=. read -r node_major node_minor _ <<EOF
$node_ver
EOF
node_major=${node_major:-0}
node_minor=${node_minor:-0}
if [ "${node_major##+(0)}" = "" ]; then node_major=0; fi
if [ "${node_minor##+(0)}" = "" ]; then node_minor=0; fi
if [ "$node_major" -lt 18 ] || { [ "$node_major" -eq 18 ] && [ "$node_minor" -lt 0 ]; }; then
  echo "Node version $node_ver detected; require Node >=18.0.0" >&2
  exit 4
fi

# determine workspace owner robustly
owner=$(stat -c '%U' "$WS" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$owner" ] || [ "$owner" = "root" ]; then
  owner=$(id -un 2>/dev/null || echo root)
fi

# compute npm global bin safely
# default for root or fallback
npm_gbin="/usr/local/bin"
if [ "$owner" != "root" ]; then
  # try to run npm bin -g as the workspace owner without prompting for a password
  if sudo -n -u "$owner" true 2>/dev/null; then
    npm_gbin_candidate=$(sudo -n -u "$owner" sh -lc 'npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || printf ""' || true)
    if [ -n "$npm_gbin_candidate" ]; then
      npm_gbin="$npm_gbin_candidate"
    fi
  fi
fi
# final fallback
: "${npm_gbin:=/usr/local/bin}"

# verify sudo usable non-interactively for writing /etc/profile.d
if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "sudo requires a password or is unavailable; persistence to /etc/profile.d requires sudo without a password. Aborting." >&2
  exit 5
fi

# Prepare idempotent profile snippet
tmp=$(mktemp)
cat >"$tmp" <<EOF
# Generated by playwright setup - will add npm global bin and CI if not set
# DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY

# add npm global bin if missing
if ! echo "\$PATH" | /bin/grep -q -F "$npm_gbin"; then
  export PATH="$npm_gbin:\$PATH"
fi
# export CI only if not already set
if [ -z "${CI:-}" ]; then
  export CI=true
fi
# ensure PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD is not set for installs
unset PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD || true
EOF

# Ensure /etc/profile.d exists and write idempotently
sudo mkdir -p /etc/profile.d
if sudo cmp -s "$tmp" /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh 2>/dev/null; then
  rm -f "$tmp"
else
  sudo mv "$tmp" /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh && sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh
fi

# source for immediate effect (best-effort)
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh || true

# record versions for traceability
mkdir -p "$WS/.artifacts"
printf "%s\n%s\n" "node:$node_ver" "npm:$(npm -v)" > "$WS/.artifacts/runtime_versions.txt"

exit 0

steps.name: scaffolding - initialize Playwright project files safely matching module type
steps.description: Create minimal Node project if missing, detect package.json 'type' to pick CommonJS or ESM scaffolding, set 'test' script only if absent, create tests and .artifacts directories, and avoid overwriting existing files (backup when present). Ensures generated config and tests are compatible with project's module system.

output_scripts.name: scaffold
output_scripts.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Minimal, idempotent Playwright scaffolding matching project's module type
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
cd "$WS"
mkdir -p "$WS/.artifacts" "$WS/tests" "$WS/.artifacts/screenshots"
# ensure node and npm available
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node not found on PATH" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not found on PATH" >&2; exit 2; }
# init package.json if missing
if [ ! -f "$WS/package.json" ]; then
  npm init -y >/dev/null
fi
# detect module type safely
type_field=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.type||'') }catch(e){process.exit(0)}" 2>/dev/null || true)
is_esm=false
if [ "${type_field}" = "module" ]; then is_esm=true; fi
# set test script only if absent
existing_test_script=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); console.log((p.scripts&&p.scripts.test)||'') }catch(e){console.log('') }" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "${existing_test_script}" ]; then
  npm pkg set scripts.test="playwright test" >/dev/null
fi
# write playwright config matching module type; backup existing file(s) if present
if [ -f "$WS/playwright.config.js" ] || [ -f "$WS/playwright.config.mjs" ]; then
  # backup any existing configs to avoid overwrite
  ts=$(date +%s)
  [ -f "$WS/playwright.config.js" ] && cp "$WS/playwright.config.js" "$WS/playwright.config.js.bak.$ts" 2>/dev/null || true
  [ -f "$WS/playwright.config.mjs" ] && cp "$WS/playwright.config.mjs" "$WS/playwright.config.mjs.bak.$ts" 2>/dev/null || true
else
  if [ "$is_esm" = true ]; then
    cat > "$WS/playwright.config.mjs" <<'CFG'
// ESM Playwright config
export default {
  timeout: 30000,
  testDir: 'tests',
  use: { headless: true, screenshot: 'only-on-failure', video: 'retain-on-failure' },
  outputDir: './.artifacts'
};
CFG
  else
    cat > "$WS/playwright.config.js" <<'CFG'
/** @type {import('@playwright/test').PlaywrightTestConfig} */
module.exports = {
  timeout: 30000,
  testDir: 'tests',
  use: { headless: true, screenshot: 'only-on-failure', video: 'retain-on-failure' },
  outputDir: './.artifacts'
};
CFG
  fi
fi
# create sample test matching module type; backup existing test files if present
if [ -f "$WS/tests/example.spec.js" ] || [ -f "$WS/tests/example.spec.mjs" ]; then
  ts=$(date +%s)
  [ -f "$WS/tests/example.spec.js" ] && cp "$WS/tests/example.spec.js" "$WS/tests/example.spec.js.bak.$ts" 2>/dev/null || true
  [ -f "$WS/tests/example.spec.mjs" ] && cp "$WS/tests/example.spec.mjs" "$WS/tests/example.spec.mjs.bak.$ts" 2>/dev/null || true
else
  if [ "$is_esm" = true ]; then
    cat > "$WS/tests/example.spec.mjs" <<'TS'
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('basic page', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('https://example.com');
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle(/Example Domain/);
});
TS
  else
    cat > "$WS/tests/example.spec.js" <<'TS'
const { test, expect } = require('@playwright/test');

test('basic page', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('https://example.com');
  await expect(page).toHaveTitle(/Example Domain/);
});
TS
  fi
fi
# Ensure artifacts directory exists
mkdir -p "$WS/.artifacts"
# Final validation: print created/updated files for traceability
ls -la "$WS/playwright.config."* "$WS/tests/"* 2>/dev/null || true

steps.name: dependencies - install Playwright packages and browser binaries safely
steps.description: Ensure @playwright/test and playwright are present in package.json devDependencies idempotently; if missing, install with npm (record installed versions). Unset PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD in-process before installs. Prefer npm ci when package-lock.json exists and packages present; otherwise run npm i. Ensure .artifacts exists, run npx playwright install --with-deps chromium, capture show-deps output and exit with remediation guidance if missing system libraries, and run an explicit headless chromium smoke test. Record installed versions to .artifacts for traceability.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
cd "$WS"
mkdir -p "$WS/.artifacts"
# unset any env that would skip browser download for current process
unset PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD || true
# show versions
node -v > "$WS/.artifacts/node_version.txt"
npm -v > "$WS/.artifacts/npm_version.txt"
# check package.json for deps (robustly using node try/catch)
need_install=0
node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json'); const has=((p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['playwright'])||(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['playwright'])); const has2=((p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies['@playwright/test'])||(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['@playwright/test'])); if(!has||!has2) process.exit(1);}catch(e){process.exit(2)}" 2>/dev/null || need_install=1
# prefer not to pin to latest in CI; install only when missing and record installed versions
if [ "$need_install" -eq 1 ]; then
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev playwright@latest @playwright/test@latest
  npm list playwright --json > "$WS/.artifacts/installed_playwright.json" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
# deterministic install
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund
fi
# verify npx playwright availability
npx playwright --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npx playwright CLI not available" >&2; exit 6; }
# install chromium (with deps). Note: may require apt packages; show-deps will list missing libs
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium >/dev/null
npx playwright show-deps 2>&1 | tee "$WS/.artifacts/playwright_show_deps.txt"
# check show-deps exit code and content for common failure tokens
if ! npx playwright show-deps >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "playwright show-deps indicates issues; see .artifacts/playwright_show_deps.txt" >&2
  echo "On Ubuntu, run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libxcomposite1 libxrandr2 libxdamage1 libxkbcommon0 libgbm1 libasound2" >&2
  exit 7
fi
# verify browser installation location (cache or node_modules)
# record installed browsers list
npx playwright install --list 2>&1 | tee "$WS/.artifacts/playwright_installed_browsers.txt" || true
# headless chromium smoke test
node -e "(async()=>{try{const { chromium } = require('playwright'); const b = await chromium.launch({ headless: true }); const p = await b.newPage(); await p.goto('about:blank'); await b.close(); console.log('chromium-launch-ok');}catch(e){console.error(e); process.exit(8);}})()" > "$WS/.artifacts/chromium_smoke.txt" 2>&1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
cd "$WS"
# ensure artifacts dir
mkdir -p "$WS/.artifacts"
# export CI for this process
export CI=true
# ensure PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD is not set in-process
unset PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD || true
# run tests with json reporter for machine parsing and a human-readable log; preserve exit code
rc=0
# Use npx so local project playwright is preferred; redirect stdout to json and stderr to human log
if ! command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "npx not found on PATH; ensure node/npm are installed" >&2
  exit 2
fi
# If a config file exists, pass it; otherwise run default
CONFIG_ARG=""
[ -f "$WS/playwright.config.js" ] && CONFIG_ARG="--config=playwright.config.js"
# Run playwright test; capture both json (stdout) and human-readable stderr
# Use a temporary file for json to avoid truncation if playwright writes to stderr too
JSON_OUT="$WS/.artifacts/playwright_test.json"
LOG_OUT="$WS/.artifacts/playwright_test.log"
# Run and capture exit code without exiting this script
set +e
npx playwright test $CONFIG_ARG --reporter=json >"$JSON_OUT" 2>"$LOG_OUT"
rc=$?
set -e
# Preserve exit code behavior: provide helpful message and exit with rc if non-zero
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Playwright tests failed with exit code $rc; see $JSON_OUT and $LOG_OUT" >&2
  ls -la "$WS/.artifacts" || true
  exit "$rc"
fi
# On success list artifacts
ls -la "$WS/.artifacts" || true
exit 0

Preserves exit codes and reports artifacts location.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
cd "$WS"
# source persisted env (best-effort)
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh || true
mkdir -p "$WS/.artifacts"
# ensure dependencies present (reinstall deterministically)
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund
fi
# START: ephemeral python server
server_pid=""
python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory "$WS" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
server_pid=$!
sleep 1
if ! curl -sS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8080/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Ephemeral python server failed to respond on 8080" >&2
  kill "$server_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  exit 10
fi
# TEST: run playwright tests and capture logs
export CI=true
npx playwright test --config=playwright.config.js --reporter=json > "$WS/.artifacts/validation_playwright_test.json" 2> "$WS/.artifacts/validation_playwright_test.log" || rc=$?
rc=${rc:-0}
# STOP: terminate ephemeral server
kill "$server_pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
wait "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "validation: tests failed; see .artifacts/validation_playwright_test.log" >&2
  exit "$rc"
fi
# EVIDENCE
echo "validation: success; artifacts in $WS/.artifacts"
ls -la "$WS/.artifacts" || true
exit 0
